days.title: Western Ascent and Highland Views
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Háhyrna
stops.detail: The highest peak named Háhyrna is located on the west side of the mountain.

stops.name: Nýidalur
stops.detail: If you want to climb the Háhyrna peak, you drive from Nýidalur at the Sprengisandur to the Hagakvíslar (866 m) and ascend from there.

stops.name: Sprengisandur
stops.detail: From there you have a good view over Vonarskarð and Sprengisandur.

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

days.title: Southern Volcanic Features
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Vonarskarð
stops.detail: The high valley Vonarskarð with its high-temperature area belongs to the volcanic system of Tungnafellsjökull and lies between it and Vatnajökull.

stops.name: Hágöngur
stops.detail: The volcano Hágöngur in the southwest of the glacier belongs to the same volcanic system as the high-temperature areas at Vonarskarð.

stops.name: Þveralda
stops.detail: To the southwest, the volcanic system extends to Þveralda east of the Sprengisandur track.
